description: This file defines a template class 'OptionalType' which implements an optional value holder for any type, including methods for assignment, comparison, and state checking.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class providing an optional value container with methods for setting, clearing, and comparing the contained value.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying from another OptionalType or a value of the contained type.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operators for comparing the contained value or another OptionalType.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operators for comparing the contained value or another OptionalType.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks whether the optional contains a value.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the optional to an unset state.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Accessors for the contained value, both mutable and const versions.
